card.name: Punctuation before next science field
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words (such, comma, dash, colon, bullet, open parenthesis) that come right after a science or engineering field name and lead into a list of further fields or topics.

modes.label: List separators between fields
modes.description: A comma, dash, colon or bullet sits between items in a list of academic or science fields.
